day_shape: IRGC Navy declares Strait of Hormuz closed citing US 'breach' of memorandum, Iran's 'Minab 168' delegation departs for Switzerland with Vance trip rescheduled, IDF strikes dozens of Hezbollah sites after 50+ projectiles, Netanyahu reportedly halts Lebanon operations.

threads.label: IRGC declares Strait of Hormuz closed
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried statements from the IRGC Navy and Khatam al-Anbia Headquarters claiming the Strait of Hormuz is closed to all vessels, citing US non-implementation of a recent memorandum. JD Vance disputed Iran's closure claim per Jerusalem Post, while IRIB aired a correspondent report from the Strait.

threads.label: Iran delegation to Switzerland for nuclear talks
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said Iran's 'Minab 168' negotiating delegation — including Qalibaf, Araghchi, Bagheri, Hemmati and Bord — was departing for Switzerland to demand implementation of a five-clause memorandum. JD Vance said he expects to reschedule his Switzerland trip within days, per Jerusalem Post.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strikes and ceasefire claims
threads.summary: The IDF said Hezbollah fired 50+ projectiles overnight at Israeli troops in southern Lebanon and that it struck dozens of Hezbollah infrastructure sites in response; Hezbollah said it remained committed to the ceasefire while defending against an Israeli advance on Ali Taher ridge. IRIB and Defa Press cited Israeli Channel 12 reporting Netanyahu ordered a halt to operations without withdrawal.

threads.label: Pakistan mediation shuttle to Tehran
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi arrived in Tehran — his third announced visit in a month — to follow up on Iran-US negotiations, meeting Foreign Minister Araghchi. IRIB said Naqvi landed in Mashhad with a visit to the Imam Reza shrine on his itinerary.

threads.label: Domestic security and leadership signalling
threads.summary: Defa Press reported the Intelligence Ministry announced the arrest of three field leaders and 14 'mercenaries' of an alleged American-Zionist street sabotage network tied to a December 1404 coup attempt, alongside a meeting of branch heads convened by President Pezeshkian. Khamenei's office posted that 'every drop of blood has a price' the 'criminal assassins of the martyrs' must pay.
